newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.

text.p: A lingering bearish trend continued as shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) fell for a second week running due mainly to lack of market moving news and looming political uncertainty in the country, brokers said.
The DSE benchmark index closed 16.78 points or 1.01 percent down at 1,643.43 on a turnover of 72.1 million taka.
Of 111 traded issues 35 rose and 75 lost. "The small investors, fearing a further price fall, mounted a selling pressure," said a broker.
Apex Foods lost 219 taka to 3,424, Shine Pukur Holdings shed to 11 to 275 and Chittagong Cement was up 30 to 2,929.
